data.raw_text:
[7:20AM] #Mile12
#Ketu
#TrafficUpdate

Vehicular movement from Odo Ogun , Ajegunle and Thomas is good at the moment while approaching Irawo is slightly busy  but moving due to pedestrian crossing and early morning rush.

Immediately after Irawo, Weigh bridge down to  Owode Onirin is good. Owode Elede down to Mile 12 is not bad as well.

Navigating through under Mile 12 bridge inward Ajelogo In and out still looking good.

While Ascending and Descending Mile 12 bridge inward kosofe down to Iyana School very appreciable at the moment.

Movement from under Mile 12 bridge inward main market in perfect shape for now.

Return journey from Iyana School to Kosofe down to Mile 12 is appreciable.

Ascending and descending Mile 12 bridge inward Owode Elede,Owode Onirin, Weigh bridge,Idera, Irawo Thomas,  Ajegunle down to Odo Ogun is very encouraging as expected.

#FollowLASTMA
@lagosMOT1 
@TrafficChiefNG 
@lagostraffic961
